claims.label: AUTHOR_PROVED_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW
claims.exact_statement: For every genuine Boolean terminal core g and every d>=1 fresh point activation of probability p=2^-d, the physical control-first restriction tree satisfies sum_v w_v Delta_{i_v}U(F_v)=U(F)-pU(g)<=C_* I_ctl(F), where I_ctl(F)=2 Pr[g=-1] p d and C_*=1+2(1+e^-1)/ln(2)<4.947. The terminal pU(g) packet is retained once.
hypotheses: fresh control coordinates disjoint from terminal data
activation is one point of a d-dimensional uniform control cube
signed Delta U charges, not positive parts
U includes the empty set and uses bits

proof_dependencies.role: normalization and local Delta U interpretation; the submitted proof also derives its specialization directly

refutes: An arbitrary terminal Boolean core must be charged again at every ancestor of a fresh nested point activation
The signed U control charge for a fresh rare conjunction necessarily grows with depth or log(1/p)
does_not_prove: a bound on positive parts of every node charge
U(g)<=K I(g) for the arbitrary terminal core
claims.first_unproved_line: Control the coherent cross term when the active Boolean core changes with the ancestor, while retaining each terminal U packet and physical coordinate influence once.
